notes.note: Reviewed the TurnDeduplicator and held follow-up changes against the foreground route, exact stage witness, atomic claim and SQLite codec. Six focused suites exercised same and changed stages, legacy data, queue settlement and concurrent arrivals with a recording adapter. No live provider behavior was measured.

Reviewed the foreground send and inbox contract against the real route cases for staged replay, input conflict, cancellation and continued placement. The update describes the existing input-conflict envelope and explains when a retained result can acknowledge exact staged input.

Reviewed the turn claim comparison and SQLite owner record. New witnessed input adds exact proof beside the original content digest. The SQLite restart tests cover known-content reclaim, resolved legacy refusal, and loss of original proof.

Reviewed retained input comparison, pre-effect ownership transfer and restart. Reclaim preserves original content proof and can record a new exact witness in its atomic write; terminal acceptance retains that witness.
Reviewed terminal custody validation in the Monument guide and module map. The validator recognizes the witnessed dedup record while retaining the existing provider turn and invocation checks.
